config.description: Container for ideviceactivation settings. Note: ideviceactivation is a CLI tool; this config is for wrapper automation or reference.

config.udid.description: The UDID of the iOS device to activate/deactivate. Corresponds to -u/--udid.

config.webservice_url.description: Override the default Apple activation webservice URL. Corresponds to -s/--service.

config.enable_debug.description: Enable debug logging for network communications. Corresponds to -d/--debug.

config.batch_mode.description: Run in non-interactive mode. Corresponds to -b/--batch.

config.use_network.description: Connect to the device via network. Corresponds to -n/--network.

config.action.description: The operation to perform: 'activate', 'deactivate', or 'state'. Corresponds to subcommands.
